cohort: 234,492 pregnant women with a live birth or fetal death in Florida from March 1, 2020 to April 30, 2021
finding: Obesity is a risk factor for SARS-CoV-2 infection in pregnancy and for more severe COVID-19 illness among pregnant women, while SARS-CoV-2 infection is associated with preterm birth.
mod_finding: COVID-19 during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of Cesarean delivery (RR = 1.04).
